9px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid rgba(255,235,200,.3);background:#fff5e11a;color:var(--ink);font:500 11px var(--sans);text-align:left}.cmp-b b{font:600 12.5px 7px;border-radius:8px;background:#fff5e11f;font-size:11.5px}.cmp-hint{margin-top:7px;font-size:12px;opacity:.85}.bad{color:#ff8a6a}.cmp-ticker{position:absolute;left:10px;right:10px;top:calc(92px + 13px var(--sans);text-align:center;pointer-events:none;animation:cmpfade 4.2s forwards}@keyframes cmpfade{0%,80%{opacity:1}to{opacity:0}}body.battle #buildBtn,body.battle #res,body.battle
